Evidence exhibit

Quick readMore contextTechnical detail

Can an unfamiliar participant understand what was tested and what remains unresolved?

My example

The proposed convening exhibit would let a visitor inspect one research record: what was tested, what happened, which evidence supports it, and what changed after review.

The participant workflow is in development. This presentation is not a live Observatory connection.

in development

A practical next step

Test a reviewed, sanitized research record as a small exhibit before claiming a ready participant workflow.

Progress would mean: Visitors can explain the test, result, evidence, and remaining uncertainty.

Who needs to be involved

Exhibit builders, research custodians, reviewers, and intended visitors.

Research stage: Validation → Communication.

Agenda connection: Resource Guide, p. 15. Suggested breakout: Track B · Ecosystem best practices. Track placement and proposals are my contributions; the handouts provide the discussion context.

Participant proposals for the Widener-led, NSF-funded convening. Project examples include documented results, work in development, and proposed pilots.
